title: Classic Italian Lasagna
description: Layers of pasta, rich sauce, and a blend of cheeses create a delicious Italian dish.
instructions: Cook lasagna pasta according to package directions. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat Italian tomato sauce over medium heat.
Combine ricotta cheese, mozzarella cheese, and Parmesan cheese in a bowl. Mix well.
Spread a layer of tomato sauce in the bottom of a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Arrange 4 lasagna sheets on top of the sauce.
Spread half of the cheese mixture over the pasta.
Repeat the layers: tomato sauce, lasagna sheets, and cheese mixture.
Top with shredded mozzarella cheese and chopped basil (if using).
Cover with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until cheese is melted and bubbly.
